knowledge.companyDescription: Premier modern dental healthcare clinic in Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan. Offering state-of-the-art painless dental treatments, single-visit root canals, laser whitening, dental implants, clear aligners, and family dentistry by PMDC-certified specialists.

contactInfo.address: Plaza 42-B, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan

knowledge.workingHours: Monday to Saturday: 11:00 AM – 09:00 PM. Sunday: Emergency consultations only (24/7 hotline active).

services.name: Consultation & Digital X-Ray
services.description: Comprehensive oral examination, clinical diagnosis, and high-resolution digital X-rays.

services.name: Scaling & Ultrasonic Polishing
services.description: Deep ultrasonic plaque, tartar, and stain removal with enamel-safe gentle polishing.

services.name: Single-Visit Root Canal (RCT)
services.description: Painless computerized rotary endodontic treatment completed in a single comfortable sitting.

services.name: Laser Teeth Whitening
services.description: In-office advanced dental laser whitening brightening teeth 6 to 8 shades in 45 minutes.

services.name: Dental Implants (Titanium)
services.description: Permanent replacement for missing teeth using medical-grade German/Swiss titanium implants and porcelain crown.

services.name: Braces & Clear Aligners
services.description: Orthodontic alignment with metal, ceramic brackets, or transparent removable invisible aligners.

services.name: Kids Dentistry (Pediatric)
services.description: Fluoride therapy, cavity prevention, gentle fillings, and child-friendly dental care.

services.name: Emergency Dental Care
services.description: Immediate relief for severe toothaches, bleeding gums, fractured teeth, or trauma.

knowledge.pricingNotes: All initial consultation charges include digital X-rays. Final treatment costs depend on individual patient tooth condition after clinical evaluation.
businessPolicies: Appointments must be scheduled or confirmed in advance to minimize waiting times.
Patients are kindly requested to arrive 10 minutes prior to their booked consultation slot.
Sterilization follows strict 100% autoclave and single-use disposable equipment standards.
Accepted payment methods: Cash, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Bank Wire, Visa, and Mastercard.
knowledge.refundPolicy: For advance booking deposits or prepaid consultation charges, eligible refund requests are processed back via the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days upon written request. Once a clinical dental procedure or examination has commenced, service fees are non-refundable.
knowledge.cancellationPolicy: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 2 hours prior to the booked slot with zero cancellation fee. Rescheduling can be done via phone, WhatsApp, or through the online patient portal.

faqs.question: apki company kya service provide karti hai? / What services do you provide?
faqs.answer: Lahore Dental provides Consultation & Digital X-Rays, Ultrasonic Scaling & Polishing, Single-Visit Root Canal (RCT), Laser Teeth Whitening, Dental Implants, Braces & Clear Aligners, Kids Dentistry, and 24/7 Emergency Dental Care.

faqs.question: bhai refund kitnay din mein milta hai? / What is the refund timeline?
faqs.answer: Agar aap advance booking deposit refund karwana chahte hain, toh refund request approve hone ke baad 3 se 5 business days (working days) ke andar original payment method par bhej diya jata hai. Clinical procedure shuru hone ke baad fee non-refundable hoti hai.

faqs.question: bhai signup ka process kya hai? / How do I sign up or book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Signup ka process bohat aasan hai! Website ke top bar par 'Sign Up' button par click karein, apna Name, Email, Password aur Phone number enter karein. Account banne ke baad aap apne dashboard par appointment book aur track kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful? / Kya root canal mein dard hota hai?
faqs.answer: Bilkul nahi! Lahore Dental mein hum computerized local anesthesia aur modern rotary instruments use karte hain, jis se root canal ka treatment lagbhag painless (dard ke baghair) hota hai.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic located? / Clinic kahan par hai?
faqs.answer: Hamari clinic Plaza 42-B, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore mein waqia hai. Contact/Helpline: +92 300 1234567.

knowledge.additionalInfo: Lead Dentist: Dr. Sarah Tariq Khan (BDS, RDS) with 14+ years of clinical experience. PMDC verified. Over 12,000 satisfied smile transformations in Lahore.
